title: Help Finding Experimental Film (or films) From This Female Director

commenti.body: Thanks for your suggestion - but after a lot of digging through old hard drives from film school, I remembered it was the collected Video Works of Sadie Benning. Thanks though!

oh, sounds like you're thinking of Miranda July. her film Me and You and Everyone We Know has that experimental, art house vibe you're describing. not sure about the DVD commentary, but it's worth checking out!
I finally remembered it was the Video Works of Sadie Benning. Thanks though!
